name: continue-stmt-test-29a505efa0/continue-stmt-e
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.array lists length, push, map, indexOf, remove, removeAll, toStream, toBase64, toBase16, fromBase64 and fromBase16, excluding forEach.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; array:forEach is absent.
reason: The whole negative case includes intArr.forEach with an anonymous callback containing an illegal continue. Array forEach is outside both the supported lang.array functions and method-call allowlist, so this essential part of the case requires an unsupported feature despite supported continue/loop syntax.
test_design_notes: The @error markers assert rejection of continue outside a loop, unreachable code following continue, and continue inside a callback across a foreach boundary. Negative rejection of supported syntax remains in scope, but the callback case also depends on unsupported array:forEach.
